findings.title: Reflected XSS via input onfocus/autofocus bypass
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter into the HTML response without proper sanitization. A blacklist filter blocks common XSS vectors like 'script', 'onerror', 'onload', and single quotes, but the payload <input onfocus=alert("XSS") autofocus> bypasses the filter and executes JavaScript.

reproduction.expected: Response contains successful XSS execution and flag
